title: World Commerce Corporation / Maynard Corporation international cabal
summary: Jesse Michels tells of World Commerce Corporation / Maynard Corporation international cabal, about post-WWII at Caribbean; international, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He places that in the World Commerce Corporation, which is this Caribbean constellation of shell sort of companies.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes how his guest, a former Pentagon official named Matthew Brown, places a hidden international network inside the World Commerce Corporation, which Michels calls a Caribbean cluster of shell companies, linked in the telling to the Maynard Corporation. Names raised include Otto Scorzani and others, with a nod to a book called Secret Machines. If true, it would mean a private web of companies working behind the scenes, out of public view.
